questions.q: Booster Gold's real name is Michael Jon what?
questions.why: Booster is Michael Jon Carter, a former college football star from the future who uses time travel to become a hero.

questions.q: What is the name of Booster Gold's flying robot companion from the future?
questions.why: Skeets is a security robot from the 25th century that can fly, talk and fire a blaster, and he time-travels alongside Booster.

questions.q: From which century does Booster Gold travel back to the present day?
questions.why: Michael Carter was born in the 25th century, in a future Gotham City, before he borrowed a time machine and jumped back.

questions.q: In the Justice League International comics, which hero becomes Booster Gold's best friend and partner?
questions.why: J. M. DeMatteis and Keith Giffen, as writers, turned Booster and Ted Kord into close friends and a comedy double act.

questions.q: In which year did Booster Gold debut in Booster Gold #1?
questions.why: Booster Gold #1 came out in February 1986, making him the first major new hero after Crisis on Infinite Earths.
Writer-artist Dan Jurgens created Booster Gold; Giffen and DeMatteis later wrote his Justice League International years.

questions.q: What superhero name did Michael plan to use before a president's introduction gave him his famous new one?
questions.why: He meant to be Goldstar; after he saved Ronald Reagan, Reagan blended it with his football nickname Booster.

questions.q: In a running DC joke, what do people wrongly call Booster Gold, to his annoyance?
questions.why: People keep mangling his name into 'Buster', a recurring joke that irritates him.

questions.q: Booster stole a Legion flight ring and the force field belt of which Legion member from the Metropolis Space Museum?
questions.why: Carter took Brainiac 5's force field belt and a Legion flight ring from the displays he guarded as a night watchman.

questions.q: Which actor played Booster Gold in the seventh season of Legends of Tomorrow?
questions.why: Donald Faison played Booster Gold in Legends of Tomorrow, while Eric Martsolf was Booster in Smallville.
